name: Nerve Cathedral

All four knots are broken. Cut the organ: the lever is on the island

intro.title: NERVE CATHEDRAL
lines: A hall with no floor: an island, two rings, a rim and eight bridges over a drop.
Every bridge lights a segment at a time. The light comes first.

outro: The organ hung slack and the bridges stopped lighting. At the north rim the wall opened on a stair, going down.

messages.speaker: INES
messages.text: A cathedral with no floor, and a drop I can't see the bottom of. Every bridge lights one segment at a time.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: The light comes first, then the heat. A segment that has just gone dark is safe to cross for about four seconds.

messages.speaker: INES
messages.text: A strand as thick as a hawser runs along the rail. A brass badge is fused into it, a Port Marrow harbour badge, number 118. The harbour issued them in order.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: A knot is where the lattice is tied off. There is one on every corner of this ring. Break all four and the strands they hold go slack.

messages.speaker: TALLY PLATE
messages.text: HELD IN THE LATTICE: 1,218. Under it, in a second hand: NOT YET SUNG. The mark beside the number is the one the Vael use for a name.

messages.speaker: INES
messages.text: The organ is rooted in the island like a tooth. Every strand in the cathedral comes back to it. There's a lever low on the root, under two lamps.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: The cut lever is on the south face of the root, under the lamps. It does nothing while a knot still ties the lattice.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: The root has let go of the strands. Every bridge has stopped lighting.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: The north wall is shut. It opens when the four knots are broken and the root is cut, in either order.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: The rim wall rings hollow here, and the bone is thinner than it ought to be.

messages.speaker: A SILENT (NOTE)
messages.text: For whoever walks the bridges. I kept this under the rim. The bridges are cooler at the edges; it is the middle they keep hot.

objective: Cross the bridges to the outer ring. The light on a segment comes before the heat: cross on the dark

quality.reason: the place is a lattice over a drop: the player crosses open bridges on a clock, and every ring is a place to be seen from
quality.introduces: a lattice over a void crossed on a pulse clock: the bridges light a segment at a time, from the rim to the island, and the light comes before the heat
